# widget

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@acme/widget)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@acme/widget)

Render configurable widgets from the command line.

## Install

```bash
npm install --global @acme/widget
```

## Usage

```bash
widget render --config widget.config.json
```

Docs live at https://widget.acme.dev.
